intro_title: One of PNG's most established engineering consultancies
intro_text: We deliver professional, practical engineering for clients across the civil, residential, commercial, industrial, geotechnical and environmental sectors. On many projects we design the works and then manage them from concept to completion, acting as project engineer or supervisor on site.

why.title: Internationally trusted
why.text: Engaged on ADB-funded projects, meeting the procurement and quality standards of international development banks.

why.title: Registered engineers
why.text: Led by a Fellow of the Institution of Engineers PNG and Chartered Professional Engineer, so work meets codes of practice and public safety standards.
